editorial:
The Spengler family returns to the iconic New York City firehouse to team up with the original Ghostbusters, who have built a secret research lab to push ghost busting to the next level. The mix of new and old faces gives the movie a warm, nostalgic feel. You get to see familiar faces like Ray, Winston, and Peter alongside the younger Spenglers, and the chemistry between them makes the whole thing feel like a big family reunion. The vibe is fun, spooky, and packed with laughs. It is the kind of movie that makes you smile just seeing the proton packs back in action.

The action scenes are a blast, especially when the team faces off against the ancient evil that threatens to freeze the world. The special effects look great, and the comedy lands more often than not. On the downside, the story can feel crowded with so many characters. Still, if you grew up loving the original films or just want a fun weekend movie, this one delivers.
endingExplained: In the final battle, the ancient death god Garraka threatens to freeze New York and unleash an army of ghosts. The Ghostbusters team up, but their proton packs are not enough at first. Phoebe, who had been sidelined, joins the fight with a special proton pack. Together they combine their streams to weaken Garraka and trap him in the containment unit. The twist is that Melody, a ghost girl who befriended Phoebe, sacrifices her ghostly form to help save the day. The city is saved.
